breadcrumb: Std 6 Social Science Term-III (English) — History Unit 1: Society and Culture in Ancient Tamizhagam: The Sangam Age — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Arumuga Navalar (Jaffna), U.V.Swaminatha Iyer and Damodharam Pillai (Jaffna) strove hard and spent many years in retrieving and publishing the Tamil classics, which were originally present as palm leaf manuscripts.

en.q: Which scholar spent many years retrieving and publishing the Tamil classics from palm leaf manuscripts?
en.explanation: Arumuga Navalar and C. W. Damodharam Pillai also did so.

ta.q: பனை ஓலைச் சுவடிகளிலிருந்த தமிழ் இலக்கியங்களை ஆண்டுக்கணக்காக முயன்று பதிப்பித்தவர் ______.
ta.explanation: ஆறுமுக நாவலர், சி.வை. தாமோதரம் பிள்ளை ஆகியோரும் பதிப்பித்தனர்.

questions.quote: George L. Hart, Professor of Tamil language at the University of California, has said that Tamil is as old as Latin. The language arose as an entirely independent tradition.

en.q: Which scholar of the University of California said that Tamil is as old as Latin?
en.explanation: He said Tamil arose as an entirely independent tradition.

ta.q: தமிழ் இலத்தீனைப் போலப் பழமையானது எனக் கூறிய கலிபோர்னியா பல்கலைக்கழகப் பேராசிரியர் ______.

questions.quote: Cheran Senguttuvan went on a military expedition to North India. He brought stones from the Himalayas for making the idol of Kannagi. Another Chera king, Cheral Irumporai, issued coins in his name. Some Chera coins bear their emblem of bow and arrow.

en.q: Cheran Senguttuvan brought stones from the Himalayas for making the idol of ______.

ta.q: செங்குட்டுவன் இமயத்திலிருந்து கல் கொணர்ந்து சிலை செய்தது ______ க்காக.

questions.quote: The Pattinapaalai, a poetic work in the Pathinenkeezhkanakku, gives elaborate information of the trading activity during the rule of Karikalan. Their port Puhar attracted merchants from various regions of the Indian Ocean.

en.q: The Chola port Puhar attracted merchants from various regions of the ______.
en.explanation: Pattinapaalai gives information on trade in Karikalan's time.

ta.q: சோழரின் துறைமுகமான புகார் ______ பகுதிகளின் வணிகர்களை ஈர்த்தது.

questions.quote: Nedunchezhiyan is hailed as the most popular warrior. He defeated the combined army of the Chera, Chola and five Velir Chieftains at Talayalanganam. He is praised as the lord of Korkai. Pandya coins have elephant on one side and fish on another side.

en.q: The Pandya king who defeated the combined army of the Cheras, Cholas and five Velir chieftains at Talayalanganam was ______.
en.explanation: He is praised as the lord of Korkai.

ta.q: தலையாலங்கானத்தில் சேர, சோழ, ஐந்து வேளிர் கூட்டுப் படையை வென்ற பாண்டிய மன்னன் ______.

questions.quote: The famous Velirs were the seven patrons (Kadaiyezhu Vallalgal). They were Pari, Kari, Ori, Pegan, Ay, Adiyaman and Nalli. Kizhar was the village chief.

en.q: Which of the following was one of the seven patrons (Kadaiyezhu Vallalgal)?
en.explanation: The seven were Pari, Kari, Ori, Pegan, Ay, Adiyaman and Nalli.

ta.explanation: பாரி, காரி, ஓரி, பேகன், ஆய், அதியமான், நள்ளி ஆகியோர்.

questions.quote: The king was called kō. The coronation ceremony was known as arasukattilerudhal or mudisoottuvila. The crown prince was known as komahan.

en.q: The crown prince in the Sangam Age was known as ______.
en.explanation: The young ones were known as Ilango, Ilanchezhiyan and Ilanjeral.

ta.explanation: இளைய மைந்தர் இளங்கோ, இளஞ்செழியன், இளஞ்சேரல் எனப்பட்டனர்.

questions.quote: King held a daily durbar (naal-avai) at which he heard and resolved all the disputes. The king's court was called Arasavai. The king occupied a ceremonious throne in the court called Ariyanai.

en.q: The ceremonious throne of the king in the court was called ______.
en.explanation: The king's court was called Arasavai.

ta.q: அரசவையில் அரசர் அமர்ந்த சிறப்பு அரியணை ______ எனப்பட்டது.

questions.quote: In the capital town, the court of justice was called Avai. In the villages, Mandram served as the place for dispensing justice.

en.q: In the villages of the Sangam Age, justice was dispensed at the ______.
en.explanation: In the capital town the court of justice was called Avai.

ta.q: சங்க காலக் கிராமங்களில் நீதி வழங்கிய இடம் ______.

questions.quote: The Ur was a village, classified into perur (big village), Sirur (a small village) and Mudur (an old village). Pattinam was the name for a coastal town and Puhar was the general term for harbour town.

en.q: An old village in the Sangam Age was called ______.
en.explanation: Perur - big village; Sirur - small village; Pattinam - coastal town.

ta.explanation: பேரூர் - பெரிய ஊர்; சிற்றூர் - சிறிய ஊர்; பட்டினம் - கடற்கரை நகர்.

questions.quote: Land was classified according to its fertility. Marutham was called menpulam (fertile land). It produced paddy and sugarcane. The rest of the landscape, excluding Neithal, was called vanpulam (hard land).

en.q: Land that was hard and produced pulses and dry grains was called ______.
en.explanation: Menpulam was fertile land producing paddy and sugarcane.

ta.q: பயறு, வறண்ட தானியங்களை விளைவித்த வன்மையான நிலம் ______ எனப்பட்டது.
ta.explanation: மென்புலம் நெல், கரும்பு விளையும் வளமான நிலம்.

questions.quote: There was no restriction for women in social life. Forty women poets had lived and left behind their valuable works. Marriage was a matter of self-choice. However, chastity (karpu) was considered the highest virtue of women. Sons and daughters had equal shares in their parents' property.

en.q: Which of the following women was a poet of the Sangam Age?
en.explanation: Other women poets include Velli Veethiyar, Kakkaipadiniyar, Aathi Manthiyar and Pon Mudiyar; about forty women poets lived.

ta.q: பின்வருவோருள் சங்க காலப் பெண் புலவர் யார்?
ta.explanation: வெள்ளிவீதியார், காக்கைப்பாடினியார், ஆதிமந்தியார், பொன்முடியார் ஆகியோரும் பெண் புலவர்கள்.

questions.quote: The primary deity of the Tamils was Seyon or Murugan. Other gods worshipped during Sangam period were Sivan, Mayon (Vishnu), Indiran, Varunan and Kotravai. The Hero stone (natukkal) worship was in practice.

en.q: The primary deity of the Sangam Tamils was ______.
en.explanation: Hero stone (natukkal) worship was also in practice.

questions.quote: The Sangam literature refers to clothes (Kalingam), which were thinner than the skin of a snake. The harvest festival (Pongal) and the festival of spring, kaarthigai were some of the festivals. Indira vizha was celebrated in the capital.

en.q: In the Sangam Age, Indira vizha was celebrated in the ______.
en.explanation: Pongal (harvest) and Kaarthigai were also celebrated.

questions.quote: Karikalan was master of seven notes of music (Ezhisai Vallavan). Singing bards were called panar and viraliyar. Dancing was performed by kanigaiyar. Koothu (folk drama) was the most important cultural practice of the people. They developed the concept of Muthamizh (Iyal, Isai, Naatakam).

en.q: Karikalan, master of the seven notes of music, was known as ______.
en.explanation: Koothu was the most important cultural practice.

ta.explanation: கூத்து சங்க கால மக்களின் முதன்மைப் பண்பாட்டுக் கலை.

questions.quote: Trade existed at three levels: local, overland and overseas. The chief ports had light houses, which were called Kalangaraillangu Sudar. Warehouses for storing goods were built along the coast. Barter system was prevalent.

en.q: The three levels of trade in the Sangam Age were ______.
en.explanation: Caravans of merchants carried merchandise in oxen-driven carts.

ta.q: சங்க காலத்தில் வணிகம் நடைபெற்ற மூன்று நிலைகள் ______.
ta.explanation: வணிகர்கள் எருதுகள் பூட்டிய வண்டிகளில் பொருள் கொண்டு சென்றனர்.

questions.quote: In Madurai there were two markets: Nalangadi (the morning market) and Allangadi (the evening market). Major Ports: Musiri, Tondi, Korkai.

en.q: Which of the following was a major port of the Sangam Age?
en.explanation: Musiri, Tondi and Korkai were major ports.

ta.q: பின்வருவனவற்றுள் சங்க காலத்தின் முக்கியத் துறைமுகம் எது?

questions.quote: The Roman writer Pliny the Elder writes of Muziris in his Natural History as the 'first emporium (shopping complex) of India'. A temple of Augustus was built at Muziris, which had a Roman colony.

en.q: Pliny the Elder described Muziris in his Natural History as the 'first ______ of India'.
en.explanation: A temple of Augustus was built at Muziris, which had a Roman colony.

ta.q: பிளினி தம் 'இயற்கை வரலாறு' நூலில் முசிறியை 'இந்தியாவின் முதல் ______' என்றார்.
ta.explanation: முசிறியில் அகஸ்டஸ் கோவிலும் ரோமானியக் குடியிருப்பும் இருந்தன.

questions.quote: Following the Sangam period, the Kalabhras had occupied the Tamil country for about two and half centuries. Seevaka Chinthamani and Kundalakesi were written during this period. So the Kalabhra period is not a dark age, as it is portrayed.

en.q: The Kalabhra period is regarded as ______.
options: a period of Roman rule over the Tamil land
not a dark age, as literature flourished
a dark age without any literature or trade
the golden age of the Imperial Cholas
en.explanation: Many works under Pathinen Keezhkanakku were composed and trade and commerce continued to flourish.

ta.explanation: பதினெண்கீழ்க்கணக்கு நூல்கள் பல எழுந்தன; வணிகம் தொடர்ந்தது.
